aboutBand.title: Hi, I’m Lalit. I design where technology, business and people meet.
paragraphs: Over a quarter century in product experience design, I’ve focused on **enterprise UX transformation**: modernizing complex, mission-critical platforms without disrupting the business.
Today I lead UX across the AMI product portfolio, championing **human-centered AI** and building teams that make design a strategic driver of growth.

about.intro: Over a quarter century in product experience design, I’ve worked where technical architecture, business strategy and human behaviour meet.
paragraphs: My focus is **enterprise UX transformation**: modernizing complex, mission-critical platforms into elegant, defensible software systems without disrupting the business.

As generative systems reshape computing, I champion **human-centered AI and innovation**, building transparent interaction models where human agency and autonomous, agentic workflows work in calibrated harmony.
As a design leader, I build and mentor multidisciplinary UX teams, and move design from a reactive delivery function to a strategic catalyst for customer retention and enterprise growth.
